item.title: Pretty setting! Circa 1953 in Florida. $319,000
item.description: This has a pretty setting and a pretty backyard pool! The home is situated on the banks of the Braden River. The house was built in 1953. It is located in Bradenton, Florida. The house features a back deck overlooking the pool, wood floors, wood walls, knotty pine, fireplace, claw foot tub and lots of windows to take in the view! One bedroom, one bathroom and 898 square feet. $319,000 Contact Tracy Anderson with Preferred Shore: 214-621-6128 From the Zillow listing: Escape to your own private wa

item.title: Connecticut’s most expensive old house listing! Hillandale, C. 1900. On 268 acres. $75,000,000
item.description: Wow! Welcome to Connecticut’s most expensive old house listing! I have no words for this one! That indoor pool is pretty amazing! This is known as Hillandale. It was originally owned by the Sulzberger Family of the New York Times. Hillandale was built in 1900. It is located on 268 acres in Stamford, Connecticut. item.title: Fixer Upper Alert! Circa 1890. On 15 acres in Georgia. $299,999
item.description: This is definitely a fixer upper! There is potential there though and it has some nice acreage. The house was built in 1890. It is located on 15 acres in Sparta, Georgia. The house features a large covered front porch, tall ceilings, crown moulding, nice staircase, wide baseboards, chair rails, built-in china cabinet and bead board. There are multiple outbuildings , mature hardwood trees and open pastures. Six bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,731 square feet. $299,999 Contact Wallace Hardy with Jas

item.description: Porch goals! Wish there were more pictures, but what they show is really nice! The listing does state that more pictures will be provided on March 5th. I will try to remember and look back at the listing. The house was built sometime in the late 1800’s. It is located on 1.16 acres in Gibson, North Carolina. item.title: $85,000! Cute house! On 1 1/2 acres in Virginia. Has a creek!
item.description: This is a cute house! Pretty setting with a creek running along the front of the property. And how about that price! The house was built in 1951. It is located on 1.51 acres in Clintwood, Virginia. The house features a large covered front porch, wood floors, nice kitchen and baseboards. Pretty setting! Three bedrooms, one bathroom and 810 square feet. $85,000 Contact Karen Franks with Century 21 Bennett and Edwards: 276-393-3283 From the Zillow listing: Beautifully remodeled older home with invi

item.title: Porch goals! 5,000 square feet! Circa 1910 in North Carolina. $479,000
item.description: Porch goals! This is a big house with 5,000 square feet! The house was built in 1910. It is located on .55 acre in Lumberton, North Carolina. The house features a large wrap around front porch, wood floors, wide baseboards, leaded glass windows, pocket doors, wainscoting, transom windows and original mantels. There is a detached garage and a fire pit area. Seven bedrooms, four bathrooms and 5,000 square feet. $479,000 Contact Giuseppe Joe Terranova with RE/MAX Real Estate Exchange From the Zillo

item.title: 15 minutes to Smith Mountain Lake! Three acres in Virginia. $149,000
item.description: This house is only 15 minutes to beautiful Smith Mountain Lake! The house was built in 1900. It is located on three acres in Huddleston, Virginia. The house features a covered front porch, original wood floors, baseboards, crown moulding, french doors and a spacious kitchen. There is a detached storage shed on the property. Three bedrooms, 1,672 square feet. $149,000. Contact Michael B. LeVan with BHHS Dawson: 434-942-8393 From the Zillow listing: Turn of the 20th Century Farm house, nicely situ

item.title: The Kreeger Cabin. Circa 1850 in North Carolina. $140,000
item.description: This is a nice cabin! The cabin is known as the Kreeger Cabin. It was built by Isaac and Louisa Krieger on land purchased by his parents in 1814. The Kreeger Cabin was built in the 1850’s. It is located on .48 acre in King, North Carolina. The cabin features wood beamed ceilings, wood floors, wide baseboards and a standing seam metal roof. Two bedrooms, one bathroom and 1,135 square feet. $140,000 Contact Cathleen Turner with Preservation North Carolina: 919-832-3652 ext 240 or cturner@presnc.or

item.title: Pretty woodwork! Circa 1900 in Illinois. $165,000
item.description: There is some pretty woodwork and furniture in this house! Wish there were more pictures! The house was built in 1900. It is located on .58 acre in Peoria, Illinois. The house features a large covered front porch, wood floors, pretty staircase, beautiful china cabinet, leaded glass windows, crown moulding, wide baseboards and solid wood doors. This is a big house! Eight bedrooms, five bathrooms and 9,000 square feet. $165,000 Contact Jessica Ball with RE/MAX Traders Unlimited: 309-363-2929 From

item.title: Pretty details! Circa 1894 in Indiana. $199,900
item.description: This house has some pretty details! The exterior is really pretty. The house was built in 1894. It is located on .48 acre in Campbellsburg, Indiana. The house features a covered front porch, great kitchen stove, original fretwork, pretty staircase, beautiful foyer mirror, wide baseboards, crystal chandeliers and wainscoting. There is a detached garage on the property. Four bedrooms, two bathrooms and 3,190 square feet. $199,900 Contact Mary McCoskey Finkle with Mainstreet Realtors From the Zillo
